# The Wikipedia Studio — llms.txt
# https://thewikipediastudio.com/

> Independent Wikipedia editorial agency (not affiliated with Wikipedia or the Wikimedia Foundation). Guideline-compliant notability assessment, page creation/editing, monitoring, and entity consistency work. Published packages from $700. No approval guarantees. Paid editing disclosed.

## Primary pages
- [Home](https://thewikipediastudio.com/): Overview of Wikipedia page creation and editing services
- [Pricing](https://thewikipediastudio.com/wikipedia-page-cost/): Four published tiers from $700 to $2,500+
- [Notability checker](https://thewikipediastudio.com/wikipedia-notability-checker/): Free preliminary notability screen
- [How to choose an agency](https://thewikipediastudio.com/how-to-choose-wikipedia-agency/): Buyer guide and scam red flags
- [Services](https://thewikipediastudio.com/services/): Full service index
- [Process](https://thewikipediastudio.com/our-process/): Editorial workflow
- [Portfolio](https://thewikipediastudio.com/portfolio/): Published engagements
- [Case studies](https://thewikipediastudio.com/case-studies/): Source-first engagement narratives
- [Blog](https://thewikipediastudio.com/blog/): Policy and process guides
- [FAQ](https://thewikipediastudio.com/faq/): Straight answers without sales pitch
- [Contact](https://thewikipediastudio.com/contact/): Free notability assessment requests
- [About](https://thewikipediastudio.com/about-us/): Editorial stance and team roles
